description_en: Updates the tags for a specified file
kebab_example: aliyun bailian update-file-tag --workspace-id llm-3z7uw7fwz0vxxxx --file-id file_9a65732555b54d5ea10796ca5742ba22_xxxxxxxx --tags 标签A --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFileTag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that contains the file. For instructions on obtaining the ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 文件所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file. You can obtain the ID from the <props="china">application data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">application data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props> page by clicking the ID icon next to the file name
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心的文件 ID，您可以在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)</props>页面，单击文件名称旁的 ID 图标获取
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The list of tags to associate with the file. You can specify a maximum of 100 tags. The combined length of all tag values cannot exceed 700 characters
parameters.help_zh: 文件关联的标签列表。最多传入100个标签，所有标签字符长度总和不能超过700
parameters.name: tags

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of `Success` indicates that the request was successful

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.

`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：

true：成功。
false：失败
